suggested_tolerances.note: Net cash deltas for near-matches are derived; see per-group net_cash_delta

conventions.net_cash: Absolute (unsigned) amount. BUY/PAY_FIXED: principal+accrued+fees; SELL/REC_FIXED: principal+accrued-fees.
conventions.signed_qty: Brokers with BLANK_SIGNED/BOTH styles send negative qty for SELL and PAY_FIXED.
conventions.dealer_inversion: DEALER_BILATERAL_VIEW rows report the opposite side of the internal trade.
conventions.multi_leg: Cpty row = net of LEG_1_PAY and LEG_2_RECEIVE; direction mirrors LEG_1_PAY.
conventions.cancel_correct: CANC.Cancels_Prior -> NEW report id; CORR.Cancels_Prior -> CANC report id; CORR matches internal.
